name: aludra/instagram-embed
title: Instagram Embed
description: Live Instagram profile feed via Instagram's own public embed iframe — no developer app or API key. Loads only after a visitor clicks 'Load feed', so nothing from instagram.com fires before consent. Unofficial and undocumented by Meta: this is the same kind of endpoint that broke without notice in 2020 (Meta's old oEmbed shutdown) — verify it still works before relying on it, and always give the client a plain profile link as a fallback.
